sentences.translation: At the company drinking party, Ai took pictures of everyone.
I was able to take a beautiful picture with a smile on my face.
I posted it to Instagram without permission.
But only Kobayashi had her mouth filled with food, and her eyes were half closed.
The next morning, a message from Mr. Kobayashi arrived.
"Hey... can you turn that picture off?" The color turned blue as soon as I saw the screen.
I immediately deleted the post and sent a long apology message.
I'm really sorry. I posted without confirmation..."
The next day, I apologized directly to Mr. Kobayashi at work.
I really regret not having received the permission.
Kobayashi laughed at me saying, "If you have already deleted it, it'll be fine."
From that day on, Ai made sure that photos taken by people were posted after they were given permission.
In my phone memo, I wrote “SNS post: check with everyone in the picture.
